title: Refining and Aligning Clinical Reasoning with Health Guidelines via Formal Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2611.32247v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Clinical reasoning from incomplete or conflicting patient evidence must account for low-probability but high-risk concerns while remaining grounded in health guidelines. We introduce VerClin, an explainable framework that extracts guideline conditions, exclusions, recommendations, and priorities into executable knowledge and represents patient conversations as scoped cases. A deterministic four-valued reasoner produces traceable guideline matches while preserving uncertainty and enforcing exclusions. Multiple specialty agents then screen matched guidelines for case applicability, and a consultation model synthesizes accepted guidance through specialty recommendations and a sentence-preserving formal-constraint channel. We present accepted guidance in ascending order of the sum of its priority and trigger-strength ranks, which can surface high-risk guidance with weaker triggers. VerClin outperforms direct generation and Top-5 RAG on Healt

translated_title: 通过形式化约束细化并对齐临床推理与健康指南
translated_abstract: 面对不完整或相互矛盾的患者证据，临床推理必须兼顾低概率但高风险的问题，同时保持与健康指南的一致性。我们提出了VerClin，这是一个可解释的框架，它将健康指南中的条件、排除项、建议和优先级提取为可执行的知识，并将患者对话表示为具有作用域的病例。一个确定性的四值推理器生成可追溯的指南匹配结果，同时保留不确定性并强制执行排除项。随后，多个专科代理对匹配到的指南进行病例适用性筛查，会诊模型则通过专科建议和保留句子的形式化约束通道来综合生成被接受的建议。我们按照优先级与触发强度排名之和的升序呈现被接受的建议，这能够凸显触发强度较弱但风险较高的指南。VerClin在Healt……（摘要在此处截断，后续实验对比内容不完整）
tldr: VerClin是一个可解释的临床推理框架，它将健康指南转化为可执行知识，结合确定性四值推理器、多专科代理筛查和形式化约束通道，生成可追溯、对齐指南且能凸显高风险问题的临床建议。
